title: The Sun went out at 8:12 AM (Part 1)
lines: The Sun went out at [8:12 AM](eight twelve, A M).
And for eight minutes, nobody noticed.
Sunlight takes eight minutes and twenty seconds to reach Earth.
So the light on Kai's cereal had left the Sun before it went out.
@am_echo: "Best morning ever."
Then, at [8:20](eight twenty) and twenty seconds, the window went black.
@am_michael: "Who turned off the sky?"
Seconds later, the Moon went dark too.
@af_heart: "The Moon only shines with sunlight."
And Earth didn't stay put.
Gravity travels at light speed too, so the Sun's pull vanished at the same moment.
Earth flew off in a straight line at eighteen miles a second.
That's New York to Los Angeles in about two minutes.
@am_echo: "Are we going to freeze?"
@af_heart: "Not right away. But the cold is coming."
Plants stopped making food the moment the light did. Most would die within weeks.
Within a week, Earth's average surface would fall below zero Fahrenheit.
That's as cold as the inside of a freezer.
Within a year, minus one hundred. Colder than an average winter day at the South Pole.
The oceans would freeze on top, but the ice would keep the water below liquid.
@am_michael: "So where do we go?"
@af_heart: "Iceland. They already heat most homes with heat from underground."
One week to reach Iceland. All because...
